findings.title: Each full page drops its last item
findings.why: Array.slice excludes its end index. Subtracting one drops the last item of every full page, and the next page starts after that omitted item.

findings.title: Each full page drops its last item
findings.why: The computed end is inclusive, but slice expects an exclusive bound. A page size of one returns an empty page even when an item exists.

findings.title: Reject fractional page sizes
findings.why: The size check accepts 1.5. Slice truncates fractional offsets while pageCount uses the fraction, so the page metadata no longer describes fixed-size groups of items.
findings.check: After fixing the end bound, test pageSize = 1.5 and require a RangeError, as with fractional page numbers.
